description: This file contains shell script code for testing various git commit scenarios, focusing on authorship, message copying, and commit amendments. It includes functions for extracting commit headers and bodies, as well as multiple test cases for different git commit options and behaviors.

methods.name: author_header
methods.description: Extracts the author header from a commit hash.

methods.name: message_body
methods.description: Extracts the message body from a commit hash.

methods.name: sha1_file
methods.description: Converts a string to a Git object file path.

methods.name: remove_object
methods.description: Removes a Git object file based on its content.
